use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES

use Cell = (row: int, column: int)
use Shape = List[Cell]

at(row: int, column: int) -> Cell => (row = row, column = column)

reading_order(a: Cell, b: Cell) -> int =>
    if a.row != b.row then a.row - b.row else a.column - b.column fi

has(shape: Shape, cell: Cell) -> bool => shape |> any(c => c =~ cell)

height(shape: Shape) -> int =>
    shape |> map(c => c.row) |> reduce(0, int.max) + 1

width(shape: Shape) -> int =>
    shape |> map(c => c.column) |> reduce(0, int.max) + 1

normalised(cells: Iterable[Cell]) -> Shape is
    let list = cells |> collect_list()
    let top = list |> map(c => c.row) |> reduce(list[0].row, int.min)
    let left = list |> map(c => c.column) |> reduce(list[0].column, int.min)

    list
        |> map(c => at(c.row - top, c.column - left))
        |> sort(reading_order)
        |> collect_list()
si

key(shape: Shape) -> string =>
    shape |> map(c => "{c.row},{c.column}") |> join(" ")

canonical(shape: Shape) -> Shape is
    let forms = LIST[Shape]()
    let current mut = shape

    for _ in 0..4 do
        current = normalised(current |> map(c => at(c.column, -c.row)))
        forms.add(current)
        forms.add(normalised(current |> map(c => at(c.row, -c.column))))
    od

    forms |> reduce(forms[0], (best, f) =>
        if key(f) <> key(best) < 0 then f else best fi)
si

grow(shapes: List[Shape]) -> List[Shape] is
    let seen = MAP[string, Shape]()

    for shape in shapes do
        for cell in shape do
            for (dr, dc) in [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)] do
                let next = at(cell.row + dr, cell.column + dc)

                if !has(shape, next) then
                    let cells = shape |> cat([next]) |> collect_list()
                    let bigger = canonical(cells)

                    seen[key(bigger)] = bigger
                fi
            od
        od
    od

    seen.values |> sort((a, b) => key(a) <> key(b)) |> collect_list()
si

row_of(shape: Shape, row: int) -> string =>
    (0..width(shape))
        |> map(column => has(shape, at(row, column)))
        |> map(filled => if filled then "#" else " " fi)
        |> join("")

art(shapes: List[Shape]) -> Pipe[string] =>
    let tallest = shapes |> map(height) |> reduce(0, int.max) in
    (0..tallest)
        |> map(row => shapes |> map(s => row_of(s, row)) |> join("  "))
        |> map(line => line.trim_end())

let levels = LIST[List[Shape]]([LIST([LIST([at(0, 0)])])])

while levels.count < 10 do
    levels.add(grow(levels[levels.count - 1]))
od

for (i, shapes) in levels |> index() do
    write_line("{i + 1,2} cells: {shapes.count,5} free polyominoes")
od

write_line("")
write_line("the twelve of size five:")

art(levels[4]) |> each(line => write_line(line))

let sixes = levels[5]
let size = 12.0D
let columns = 7
let panel = 90
let rows = (sixes.count + columns - 1) / columns
let image = IMAGE(columns * panel, rows * panel)
let tiles = SHAPES()

image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 245ub)

for (i, shape) in sixes |> index() do
    let left = cast double(i % columns * panel + 12)
    let top = cast double(i / columns * panel + 12)

    for c in shape do
        let x = left + size * cast double(c.column)
        let y = top + size * cast double(c.row)
        let far = size - 1.0D

        tiles.add(
            [
                (x = x, y = y), (x = x + far, y = y),
                (x = x + far, y = y + far), (x = x, y = y + far)
            ],
            (60ub, 110ub, 200ub))
    od
od

image.fill(tiles)
image.write("hexominoes.png")

image.show("hexominoes.png")
